package.description: Modern dual-pane file manager for Windows with Git, terminal, archives, and AI.

en-US.description: Modern dual-pane file manager for Windows with Git, terminal, archives, and AI.
en-US.longDescription: Provix is a WPF file manager for Windows featuring dual-pane navigation, tabs, bookmarks, file preview, folder compare, a built-in PowerShell terminal, Git integration, password-protected archives, folder encryption to ZIP, and AI-powered file automation via OpenRouter.
en-US.name: Provix
